source.text: ወሶበ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ ጽድቅ፡ በገጾሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ እለ፡ ኅሩያን፡ ተግባሮሙ፡ ስቁል፡ በእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ ወያስተርኢ፡ ብርሃን፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ወለኅሩያን፡ እለ፡ *የኃድሩ፡ ዲበ፡ የብስ፡ አይቴ፡ መኃደሪ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ወአይቴ፡ ምዕራፎሙ፡ ለእለ፡ ክሕድዎ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ እምኃየሶሙ፡ ሶበ፡ ኢተወልዱ።
source.note: Unapplied selected-edition candidate from direct Charles 1906 scan inspection. Printed critical signs retained; apparatus reference numerals omitted and punctuation normalized. No independent manuscript, human specialist, oracle or modern-critical-edition certification. Author review is not independent approval.

translation.text: and when righteousness appears on the faces of the righteous, the chosen whose deeds hang upon the Lord of Spirits,[a] and light appears to the righteous and chosen who dwell on the dry land, where will sinners dwell, and where will those who denied the Lord of Spirits find rest? It would have been better for them not to have been born.

footnotes.text: The unusual expression 'whose deeds hang upon the Lord of Spirits' is retained; 'whose deeds depend on the Lord of Spirits' is another possible construal. The selected main text reads righteousness, not a silently substituted personal title.

source.text: ሶበ፡ ይትከሠት፡ ኅቡኣቲሆሙ፡ ለጻድቃን፡ ይትኴነኑ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ ወይትሀወዙ፡ ረስዓን፡ እምገጸ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወኅሩያን።
source.note: Unapplied selected-edition candidate from direct Charles 1906 scan inspection. Printed critical signs retained; apparatus reference numerals omitted and punctuation normalized. No independent manuscript, human specialist, oracle or modern-critical-edition certification. Author review is not independent approval.

translation.text: When the hidden things of the righteous are revealed,[a] sinners will be judged, and the wicked will be driven away from the presence of the righteous and chosen.

footnotes.text: Or 'the secrets of the righteous.' The text does not specify what those hidden things are.

source.text: ወእምይእዜ፡ ኢይከውኑ፡ *ዐዚዛነ፡ ወእልዑላነ፡ እለ፡ ይእኅዝዋ፡ ለምድር፡ ወኢይክሉ፡ ርእየ፡ *ገጸ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ እስመ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ አርአየ፡ ብርሃኖ፡ በገጸ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወኅሩያን።
source.note: Unapplied selected-edition candidate from direct Charles 1906 scan inspection. Printed critical signs retained; apparatus reference numerals omitted and punctuation normalized. No independent manuscript, human specialist, oracle or modern-critical-edition certification. Author review is not independent approval.

translation.text: From then on, those who possess the earth will no longer be mighty and exalted, nor will they be able to look upon the face of the holy ones, because the Lord of Spirits has shown his light on the face of the holy, righteous and chosen ones.[a]

footnotes.text: Charles 1906 printed page 77 notes 42 and 44 identify editorial emendations in this clause. The final descriptor 'righteous' is also flagged as possibly interpolated in note 45. This follows the selected edited text, not independently verified manuscript wording.

source.text: ወነገሥት፡ ወዓዚዛን፡ በውእቱ፡ ጊዜ፡ *ይትኃጐሉ፡ ወይትወሀቡ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወቅዱሳን።
source.note: Unapplied selected-edition candidate from direct Charles 1906 scan inspection. Printed critical signs retained; apparatus reference numerals omitted and punctuation normalized. translation.text: At that time kings and mighty ones will perish and be handed over into the hands of the righteous and holy ones.[a]

footnotes.text: The selected edition marks the perish verb and records differing readings in printed page 78 note 3. The wording follows that edition without claiming an independent manuscript adjudication.

source.text: ወ*እምህየ፡ አልቦ፡ ዘያስተምሕር፡ ሎሙ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ [እስመ፡ ተወድአ፡ እንቲአሆሙ፡ ሕይወት።
source.note: Unapplied selected-edition candidate from direct Charles 1906 scan inspection. Printed critical signs retained; apparatus reference numerals omitted and punctuation normalized. No independent manuscript, human specialist, oracle or modern-critical-edition certification. Author review is not independent approval.

translation.text: From then on there will be no one to plead for mercy for them with the Lord of Spirits, because their life has come to an end.[a]

footnotes.text: Charles places an opening interpolation bracket before 'because their life has come to an end'; it continues across the chapter boundary and closes in 39:2. This clause is retained transparently as bracketed material in the selected edition, not certified as original. The Ge'ez source intentionally preserves the open bracket at this verse boundary.

source.text: ወዝ፡ ካልእ፡ ምሳሌ፡ ዲበ፡ እለ፡ ይክሕዱ፡ ስሞ፡ ለማኅደረ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ወእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡
source.note: Unapplied selected-edition candidate from direct Charles 1906 scan inspection. Printed critical signs retained; apparatus reference numerals omitted and punctuation normalized. No independent manuscript, human specialist, oracle or modern-critical-edition certification. Author review is not independent approval.

translation.text: This is another parable concerning those who deny the name of the dwelling of the holy ones and of the Lord of Spirits.[a]

footnotes.text: The relation of 'the name', 'the dwelling of the holy ones' and 'the Lord of Spirits' is awkward in the edited Ge'ez. The wording is retained rather than silently deleting the dwelling phrase or rewriting its relation to the name.

source.text: ወኢሰማየ፡ የዐርጉ፡ ወኢምድረ፡ ይበጽሑ፡ ከመ*ዝ፡ ይከውን፡ ክፍለ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ እለ፡ ክሕዱ፡ ስሞ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ እለ፡ ከመዝ፡ ይትዐቀቡ፡ ለዕለተ፡ ስራሕ፡ ወምንዳቤ።
source.note: Unapplied selected-edition candidate from direct Charles 1906 scan inspection. Printed critical signs retained; apparatus reference numerals omitted and punctuation normalized. No independent manuscript, human specialist, oracle or modern-critical-edition certification. Author review is not independent approval.

translation.text: They will not ascend to heaven or reach the earth. This will be the lot of sinners who denied the name of the Lord of Spirits, who are thus kept for the day of affliction and distress.[a]

footnotes.text: The Ge'ez pairs terms for affliction or oppression and distress; the two terms are preserved rather than reduced to a generic day of judgment.

source.text: በይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ይነብር፡ ዲበ፡ መንበረ፡ ስብሐት፡ ኅሩየየ፡ ወ†የኀሪ፡ ምግባሪሆሙ፡ ወምዕራፎሙ፡ ኍልቈ፡ አልቦ፡ ወነፍሶሙ፡ በማእከሎሙ፡ ትጸንዕ፡ ሶበ፡ ርእይዎሙ፡ ለኅሩያነ፡ ዚአየ፡ ወለእለ፡ ሰከዩ፡ ስምየ፡ ስቡሐ።
source.note: Unapplied selected-edition candidate from direct Charles 1906 scan inspection. Printed critical signs retained; apparatus reference numerals omitted and punctuation normalized. No independent manuscript, human specialist, oracle or modern-critical-edition certification. Author review is not independent approval.

translation.text: On that day my Chosen One will sit on the throne of glory and choose their works.[a] Their resting places will be numberless,[b] and their souls will grow strong within them when they see my chosen ones and those who have called upon my glorious name.[c]

footnotes.text: The printed dagger marks 'choose' as corrupt. Charles 1906 printed page 85 note 21 proposes an underlying 'try/examine' through a Hebrew or Aramaic explanation. 'Choose' retains the printed Ge'ez rather than silently installing that reconstruction. The reconstruction is the editor's proposal, not an additional manuscript witness.
Literally, 'their rest, a number there is not.' The clause is separated from the preceding works phrase rather than made another object of 'choose'.

Dillmann’s 1865 lexicon, column383, cites this verse under approaching or appealing to someone in prayer or for help. “Called upon” follows that sense, not the separate accusation sense. The printed verse shifts from singular “my Chosen One” to plural “my chosen ones”; the shift is retained.

source.text: በይእቲ፡ ዕለት፡ አነብር፡ ማእከሎሙ፡ ለኅሩየ፡ ዚአየ፡ ወእዌልጦ፡ ለሰማይ፡ ወ*እገብራ፡ በረከተ፡ ወ*ብርሃነ፡ ለዓለም።
source.note: Unapplied selected-edition candidate from direct Charles 1906 scan inspection. Printed critical signs retained; apparatus reference numerals omitted and punctuation normalized. translation.text: On that day I will settle my Chosen One among them, and I will transform heaven and make it a blessing and a light forever.

source.text: ወእዌልጦ፡ ለየብስ፡ ወእገብራ፡ *በበረከት፡ ወለኅሩያነ፡ ዚአየ፡ አነብሮሙ፡ ውስቴታ፡ ወለእለ፡ ይገብሩ፡ ኃጢአተ፡ ወጌጋየ፡ ኢይከይዱ፡ ውስቴታ።
source.note: Unapplied selected-edition candidate from direct Charles 1906 scan inspection. Printed critical signs retained; apparatus reference numerals omitted and punctuation normalized. No independent manuscript, human specialist, oracle or modern-critical-edition certification. Author review is not independent approval.

translation.text: I will transform the dry land and make it blessed. I will settle my chosen ones in it, but those who commit sin and transgression will not walk in it.

source.text: እስመ፡ አነ፡ ርኢኩ፡ ወአጽገብክዎሙ፡ በሰላም፡ ለጻድቃንየ፡ ወአንበርክዎሙ፡ ቅድሜየ፡ ወቀርበት፡ ኀቤየ፡ ኵነኔ፡ ኃጥኣን፡ *ከመ፡ አሕጕሎሙ፡ እምገጸ፡ ምድር።
source.note: Unapplied selected-edition candidate from direct Charles 1906 scan inspection. Printed critical signs retained; apparatus reference numerals omitted and punctuation normalized. No independent manuscript, human specialist, oracle or modern-critical-edition certification. Author review is not independent approval.

translation.text: For I have seen, and I have satisfied my righteous ones with peace[a] and settled them before me. The judgment of sinners has drawn near to me, so that I may destroy them from the face of the earth.

footnotes.text: The selected text reads 'I have seen'; 'seen to/provided for' is a possible contextual interpretation, but this candidate does not silently substitute it. Charles records differing forms of this verb in printed page 86 note 1. Satisfaction is explicitly with peace, not an unstated object.
